capabilities.name: model.build
capabilities.description: Build a parametric 3D model from a structured spec and export it to STEP and STL. Deterministic: the spec fully determines the geometry, and no model class is consulted.

input_schema.description: The node contract carries payloads as a flat map of string to string, so every slot below is a STRING - including 'spec', which is a JSON object encoded as a string rather than a nested object.

spec.description: JSON object encoded as a string: {"shape": "box|plate|bracket|cylinder", "dimensions_mm": {...}, "features": [...]}.

formats.description: Comma-separated subset of 'step,stl'. Defaults to both.

name.description: Base filename for the exported artifacts. Defaults to 'model'.

output_schema.description: Also a flat map of string to string; numeric values are decimal strings and booleans are 'true'/'false'.
